title: Polish-Style Meat Dumplings
description: A hearty, comforting dish from Poland featuring meat-filled dumplings in a savory broth.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, egg, and water to form dumpling dough.
Knead dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place a tablespoon of ground meat in the center of each disk.
Fold dough over meat to form a dumpling, pressing edges together to seal.
In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Brown dumplings on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add beef broth, onion, carrot, and celery to the pot.
Bring broth to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add polish sausage (if using) and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
